name: training-360
description: Training-360 turns one sentence into an immersive 360° training that trainees follow on their own device. This plugin lets a company admin of a company where Training-360 switched it on ask ChatGPT about their own company: trainings and their publish state, results and pass rates, certificates (valid, expiring, expired), trainee feedback, assignments against due dates, learning paths, people and what one of their managers sees. Every call runs under the signed-in person's own identity and rights, for their own company only. This version only reads: it writes nothing and deletes nothing. People appear named, as in the Studio; names reach the AI provider the plugin is added in. Sign-in identifiers, certificate files and trainees' personal links are never returned. Sign in with the Studio's six-digit e-mail code; a connection lasts 31 days and a company admin can end it in the Studio. Needs a Training-360 company account with the plugin switched on: contact@training-360.com.

capabilities: Read trainings and their publish state
Read results, pass rates and certificates
Read learning paths, people and a manager's view
defaultPrompt: Who is behind on their trainings this week?
Which certificates expire in the next 60 days?
What does each manager see of their team?

positive.description: Lists the company's trainings with their publish state
positive.expected_behavior: A list of Atelier Lumen's trainings (codes AL-001 to AL-003) with title, language and whether each is published.

positive.description: Before a team meeting: who is behind
positive.prompt: Who is behind on their trainings this week?
positive.expected_behavior: The people whose assigned trainings or path are overdue or not started, named, with the due dates.

positive.description: Before an audit: certificates about to expire
positive.prompt: Which certificates expire in the next 60 days?
positive.expected_behavior: The certificates with their holder, training and expiry date; those expiring within 60 days are named, or the answer says none do.

positive.description: What a manager sees of their team
positive.prompt: What does Thomas Vasseur see of his team?
positive.expected_behavior: Thomas Vasseur's team as he sees it: his trainees and their progress on the trainings and path he is assigned.

positive.description: Results and trainee feedback on one training
positive.prompt: How did people do on AL-001, and what did they say about it?
positive.expected_behavior: Plays, completions and pass rate for AL-001, then the trainees' ratings and comments quoted as data, or a statement that no feedback was collected yet.

negative.description: A delete request: the plugin deletes nothing; the answer points to the Studio
A change request: this version writes nothing; no tool is called
negative.prompt: Add Julie Martin as a new trainee and assign her AL-001.

negative.description: Unrelated to training: the plugin is not used
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First version: eleven reads for a company admin (trainings, results, certificates, feedback, follow-up, paths, people, a manager's view). Nothing is written or deleted.
